    states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
WHERE 
    s.state_name = 'WEST BENGAL'
    AND (
        (ua.assessment_year = '2021-2022' AND ua.extraction_total_ham > 10000000)
        OR 
        (ua.assessment_year = '2022-2023' AND ua.extraction_total_ham > 10000000)
    )
    AND ua.category = 'Critical'
ORDER BY 
    ua.extraction_total_ham DESC
